headline: NNPC Remittances to Nigerian Government Decline
summary: The Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited (NNPC) reported a marginal decline in statutory remittances to the federal government, totaling N11.14 trillion over the first nine months of the year.
why: NNPC is the state-owned oil company and the primary source of government revenue in Nigeria, making its financial performance vital to the national budget.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Lower remittances reduce government fiscal space and public spending capacity.
